correctness.rationale: PASS: Under lax team splitting, dep(x,y) OR dep(x,z) holds exactly when every x-fiber is a subset of one designated y-row union z-column cross. Choices for distinct x-values are independent, hence F_{m,r,s}(t)=H_{r,s}(t)^m. Enumerating all rs crosses by their (r+s-1)-cell subset polynomials and subtracting the precise excess multiplicities from the empty set, singleton sets, row subsets, column subsets and two-point diagonal pairs gives the stated explicit H. These overlap classes are exhaustive: distinct crosses intersect in a row, column or two opposite cells. Bernoulli probability follows by summing p^k(1-p)^(mrs-k) over counted teams; q=2 full teams total 225.
